summary: Frontend-only verification of new collapse-sidebar feature across Super Admin, Admin Provinsi, and Mahasiswa dashboards on desktop (1920x1080) plus mobile (390x844). All six acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardShell.jsx defines the inner Sidebar component inside the render function. Every parent re-render creates a NEW component type, forcing React to unmount/remount the entire sidebar subtree on each state change. This works today but (a) throws away focus/scroll state inside the drawer, (b) is wasteful, and (c) makes cached element handles stale for automated tests. Move Sidebar to a top-level component and pass props (menu, active, onSelect, collapsed, setCollapsed, mobile, logoUrl, brandLabel, doLogout) instead of relying on closure.
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Super Admin, Admin Provinsi, Mahasiswa demo accounts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified per-role: (1) desktop sidebar starts expanded (width 256) after login/refresh for all 3 roles; (2) sidebar-collapse-toggle has aria-label 'Tutup sidebar' and hover tooltip 'Tutup sidebar' when expanded; clicking collapses to width 80, hides brand text, updates aria-label + hover tooltip to 'Buka sidebar', and shifts main content margin-left to 80px; (3) clicking again re-expands to 256; (4) after refresh from a collapsed state, sidebar returns to expanded (no persistence, matches spec); (5) at 390px mobile, sidebar-toggle opens the drawer, mobile-sidebar-collapse-toggle collapses it to 80 with no horizontal overflow and the bottom control stays within viewport (bottom=792 of 844); (6) collapsed menu icons carry aria-labels equal to their menu names and clicking one still switches the active view. Note: the inner Sidebar component is redefined every render, so playwright element handles become stale after state changes — always re-query by data-testid instead of caching handles.
